pharmacology.text: AM-2232 (1-(4-cyanobutyl)-3-(naphthalen-1-oyl)indole) is a drug that acts as a potent but unselective agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with a Ki of 0.28 nM at CB1 and 1.48 nM at CB2. In the United States, all CB1 receptor agonists of the 3-(1-naphthoyl)indole class such as AM-2232 are Schedule I Controlled Substances.

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study the cannabinoid receptors, and has also appeared in synthetic cannabinoid products.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究大麻素受體的研究用化合物，也曾出現在合成大麻素產品中。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究大麻素受体的研究用化合物，也曾出现在合成大麻素产品中。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: Instead of the fluorine seen in AM-2201, it ends its tail with a cyano group, a carbon triple bonded to nitrogen. This is the same group that gives bitter almonds their characteristic chemistry.
fact.zh: 它的尾端不是 AM-2201 那樣的氟，而是氰基，也就是碳與氮以三鍵相連的結構。這正是苦杏仁特殊化學性質的來源基團。
fact.zhHans: 它的尾端不是 AM-2201 那样的氟，而是氰基，也就是碳与氮以三键相连的结构。这正是苦杏仁特殊化学性质的来源基团。
